name: Citrulline malate

lead: Citrulline malate combines the amino acid L-citrulline with malic acid. Citrulline is an intermediate of the urea cycle and a precursor of arginine, and is a common ingredient in pre-workout powders.

It is used for muscle pump, endurance in resistance sets and reduced soreness. Meta-analyses report a small improvement in repetitions to failure with low certainty, and single trials often show no effect.

paras: Citrulline is converted to arginine in the kidney, which raises nitric oxide production and blood vessel dilation. It may also help clear ammonia and lactate-related fatigue, and malate may feed energy metabolism, though these steps have not been firmly established for performance.

Citrulline malate is legal and generally well tolerated; the main reported complaint is stomach upset at larger amounts. It can lower blood pressure slightly, which is relevant for people taking antihypertensive or erectile dysfunction drugs. Benefits for muscle size have not been established.
